visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, chestnut-brown hair styled in a side braid with a voluminous white bow sits centered in a bright, modern studio. She wears a blue denim off-the-shoulder dress. Her facial expressions are animated, with frequent eyebrow movements and direct eye contact with the camera. Her hands are active, gesturing to emphasize her speech. The background features large windows showing a blurry urban view and a white sofa. A red speech bubble with black text and a chili icon remains static on the left. (2) The footage cuts to various drama scenes. First, a man with glasses and a woman with short hair sit in the back of a car; the man appears to be sleeping while the woman looks at him with a neutral expression. Then, a different woman with long hair is seen on a phone, looking distressed in a dim indoor setting. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom center. The lighting shifts from warm car interiors to cool-toned office/home environments. (3) The camera returns to the primary speaker in the studio. She maintains the same posture, leaning forward slightly as she speaks with increased intensity. Her hand gestures become more forceful, pointing and opening her palms toward the audience. The lighting is consistent, bright, and flat, typical of professional studio setups. (4) Another series of drama clips shows the man from before in a striped shirt. In one scene, an older woman (his mother) aggressively feeds him with a spoon while he looks passive. A visual overlay of the character "媽" (Mother) repeats multiple times around his head in a white, bold font. The scenes are fast-paced with quick cuts between the man's face and his wife's frustrated expressions. (5) Final shot of the woman in the studio. She concludes her speech with a knowing smile and a final hand gesture. The visual remains clean and focused on her upper body and face.
